hosted.network_scope: Credential-free replay with no network operations requested; host network is not physically disabled. No physical network-none claim.
hosted.failure_retention: Always upload the new owned reception directory including all ten original ZIPs, complete expanded members, full before/after API pages, per-stage receipts and failed/partial outputs; no erase, overwrite, automatic retry or rerun. Infrastructure loss or failed upload stays incomplete, not green-by-assumption.

Header and end give whole bytes/SHA/count; every ordered base64 chunk gives its own bytes/SHA/index. Frames encode original file bytes; JSON is parsed only after exact reassembly.
